definitions.gloss: rejection (of an application); not being hired; not being adopted
definitions.explanation: The result of not being selected in a job application, proposal, or submission. The opposite of being accepted or hired.

examples.japanese: {残念|ざんねん}ながら{不採用|ふさいよう}となりました。
examples.english: Unfortunately, your application was not accepted.

examples.japanese: {三社|さんしゃ}{連続|れんぞく}で{不採用|ふさいよう}だった。
examples.english: I was rejected by three companies in a row.

examples.japanese: {不採用|ふさいよう}の{通知|つうち}を{受|う}け{取|と}って{落|お}ち{込|こ}んだが、{気持|きも}ちを{切|き}り{替|か}えた。
examples.english: I was discouraged when I received the rejection notice, but I changed my mindset.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly encountered in job hunting ({就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}). Rejection notifications are sometimes called {不採用|ふさいよう}{通知|つうち} or, colloquially, お{祈|いの}りメール ("prayer email"), because they typically include the phrase 「ご{活躍|かつやく}をお{祈|いの}りします」.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不採用|ふさいよう}{通知|つうち} (rejection notice)
- {不採用|ふさいよう}になる (to be rejected)
- {書類|しょるい}{選考|せんこう}で{不採用|ふさいよう} (rejected at the document screening stage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {採用|さいよう}: hiring, adoption (the opposite)
- {不合格|ふごうかく}: failure (on an exam; different context)
